dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Ina, Kari, allow me to pass the message on your behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: M—Miss Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Ah... Well... we wouldn't wanna trouble you. Granny Sarakka says you're always busy, so it'd be best not to disturb you with small stuff like this...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I do happen to be free at the moment. And yes, I did hear what you said.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: In which case, allow me to ask this puffin if it recognizes your friend.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Dear child. Do you know the little puffin Ina and Kari took care of previously?

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Friend, friend! Know, yes! At home! Too long away, danger, danger!)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Papa, Mama, worried. Papa, Mama, stopped it from leaving!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...I see. Ina, it seems your deduction was spot on.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Your friend is currently stuck at home, getting an earful from its parents for being away for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Wow, you're pretty smart, Ina!

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Hehe, I do read a lot of books normally, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Friend, good! Friend, want to see! Come to home, hurry to home!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Hmm? It seems... this puffin says that your friend also misses you.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It can't go outside right now, but you could... go be its guests instead?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Huh? Could we? But I don't even know where it lives...

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: And if we're out of doors for too long, we'll be the ones getting scolded by our parents...

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (Lady Lauma. Allow me to escort the two children. It is not far to go from here — a round trip shall not even take half a day.)

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (It is no ill deed to help old friends meet again.)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (I'll lead the way! Lead the way! I fly high! I know the shortcuts!)

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: What are they saying, Lauma?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It would seem that your previous concerns have been resolved.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: This puffin is willing to take you to see your friend, and this deer wishes to escort you there and back again.

dialogues.speaker: Ina
dialogues.text: Wow? Really? Is that true, Miss Lauma, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Of course it is. Have I ever lied to you?

dialogues.speaker: Kari
dialogues.text: Ohh, that's... that's great! Thank you! And thank you, too!

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (Easy-peasy, leave it to me-see!)

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (Mmm. Of wholesome heart and polite, these children are. Lady Lauma, they shall be safe with us.)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I shall be counting on you two, then. Please come to the library once your task is done. I have a gift for you.

dialogues.speaker: Rimehorn Deer
dialogues.text: (You are most welcome, Lady Lauma. There is no need for such decorum when aiding family.)

dialogues.speaker: Puffin
dialogues.text: (I wanna eat fruit! So does he! He wants 'em too, but he won't say!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hehe. In that case, I shall prepare the sweetest of fruits for you both.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Come, Ina, Kari. When you hop on, be sure to sit tight.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Don't look up as you pass through the woods, and don't reach out your hands. Just stay low and stay seated, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Ina & Kari
dialogues.text: Okay, Miss Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ina and Kari climb atop the Rimehorn Deer's back. Afterward, the puffin begins flying, with the deer following closely. Very quickly, the two people and two animals disappear from sight...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I hope you have a wonderful time, dear children.
